units.title: SG-2.1 · Merge duplicate content loader/validator into one module
Act: Port strict field validation into loader.ts loadWorld
Verify: loadWorld strict loading unit tests

tests.id: loader.test.ts > loadWorld > throws when id is missing
tests.name: loadWorld throws when id is missing
tests.title: loadWorld throws when world.yaml has no id
tests.scenario: Given world.yaml without an id line and a valid scenes/s.yaml, When loadWorld is called, Then it throws an error mentioning id
tests.command: npx vitest run tests/loader.test.ts --testTimeout=10000 -t "id is missing"
tests.detail: Error 'world.yaml missing string field: id' matches /id/.

tests.id: loader.test.ts > loadWorld > throws naming s2.yaml when a listed scene file is missing
tests.name: loadWorld throws naming s2.yaml when a listed scene file is missing
tests.title: loadWorld names the missing scene file
tests.scenario: Given world.yaml lists scenes s and s2 and only scenes/s.yaml exists, When loadWorld is called, Then it throws an error naming s2.yaml

tests.id: loader.test.ts > loadWorld > throws when a scene file declares a different id than listed
tests.name: loadWorld throws when a scene file declares a different id than listed
tests.title: loadWorld rejects a scene file whose id does not match
tests.scenario: Given world.yaml lists scene s and scenes/s.yaml declares id other, When loadWorld is called, Then it throws an error saying expected s
tests.detail: Error 'scenes/s.yaml declares id other, expected s' matches /expected s/.

tests.name: loadWorld returns scenes array
tests.title: loadWorld returns the resolved scenes as an array
tests.scenario: Given a valid world with scene s, When loadWorld is called, Then loaded.scenes is an array whose first entry has id s

units.title: Verify: loader.ts validateWorld reference unit tests

tests.id: validator.test.ts::validateWorld invalid reference detection::reports unknown scene, character, flag and object references for an invalid world
tests.name: reports unknown scene, character, flag and object references for an invalid world
tests.title: validateWorld reports unknown scene, character, flag and object references
tests.scenario: Given an invalid world with a scene referencing missing ids, When validateWorld runs, Then it reports each unknown reference

tests.id: validator.test.ts::validateWorld invalid reference detection::reports unknown start scene and unknown dialogue next
tests.name: reports unknown start scene and unknown dialogue next
tests.title: validateWorld reports unknown start scene and unknown dialogue next
tests.scenario: Given a world with startScene 'missing' and a choice whose next is 'nope', When validateWorld runs, Then it reports 'unknown scene: missing' and 'unknown dialogue: nope'

tests.id: validator.test.ts::loadWorld and validateWorld with a valid world::loadWorld returns the scene keyed by its id from scenes/s.yaml
tests.name: loadWorld returns the scene keyed by its id from scenes/s.yaml
tests.title: loadWorld resolves scenes from scenes/<id>.yaml
tests.scenario: Given a temp world dir with world.yaml and scenes/s.yaml, When loadWorld runs, Then the loaded scenes contain scene 's'
tests.detail: Assertion adapted to array form (scenes[0].id) to match loader.ts LoadedWorld contract.

tests.id: validator.test.ts::loadWorld and validateWorld with a valid world::loadWorld throws an error naming s2.yaml when world.yaml lists a scene with no file
tests.name: loadWorld throws an error naming s2.yaml when world.yaml lists a scene with no file
tests.title: loadWorld reports a missing scene file by name
tests.scenario: Given world.yaml lists scenes s and s2 but only s.yaml exists, When loadWorld runs, Then it throws an error naming s2.yaml

tests.id: validator.test.ts::loadWorld and validateWorld with a valid world::validateWorld returns no errors for the fully consistent valid fixture
tests.name: validateWorld returns no errors for the fully consistent valid fixture
tests.title: validateWorld accepts a fully consistent world
tests.scenario: Given the valid world and scene fixtures, When validateWorld runs, Then it returns an empty error list

tests.name: tests/content.test.ts (4 tests)
tests.title: Bedroom content loads and validates with no reference errors
tests.scenario: Given the the-boys-room content files, When loadWorld and validateWorld run through src/content/loader.ts, Then no reference errors are reported
tests.detail: All 4 tests in the file passed; individual names not enumerated.
